name: Enosys Loans CDP
oneLiner: CDP is Enosys's overcollateralized dollar stablecoin on Flare, minted from Flare-ecosystem collateral via Enosys Loans CDP vaults.
collateral: FXRP, wFLR, sFLR, and stXRP deposited into Enosys Loans CDP positions on Flare, with collateral priced by the Flare Time Series Oracle (FTSO)
pegMechanism: Liquity V2 friendly fork: an overcollateralized CDP with user-set borrow interest rates, a Stability Pool that absorbs liquidations, and automated redemptions against the lowest-rate positions when CDP trades below its $1 peg; collateral is priced by the Flare Time Series Oracle (FTSO)

oracleRisk.summary: Four debt-bearing Flare branches use a common Enosys PriceFeedFtsoV2Connector path through the hard-coded FlareContractRegistry into FTSOv2. The connector discards the returned feed timestamp, enforces no maximum age, caches no price, and has no alternate provider; successful reads return the oracle-failure-detected flag as false, while registry or FTSO reverts propagate instead of activating branch shutdown.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 ORCL curation
branchApplicability.rationale: At finalized Flare block 65066600 the official deployment's FXRP, wFLR, stXRP, and sFLR TroveManagers were callable, had active troves and nonzero debt, and had shutdownTime zero. No additional branch was exposed by the deployed collateral registry, so all four debt-bearing liquidation paths are retained.

branches.label: FXRP Trove branch
branches.summary: The branch PriceFeed calls the FTSOv2 XRP/USD feed through the shared connector without preserving or checking the upstream timestamp.

feeds.path: PriceFeed 0xFc35d431Ce1445B9c79ff38594EF454618D2Ec49 -> PriceFeedFtsoV2Connector implementation 0x68aa9aa27cfa5f4fa71b22e614efe408281e1295 -> hard-coded FlareContractRegistry 0xaD67FE66660Fb8dFE9d6b1b4240d8650e30F6019 -> resolved FTSOv2 0x7BDE3Df0624114eDB3A67dFe6753e62f4e7c1d20 -> XRP/USD feed 0x015852502f55534400000000000000000000000000

branches.fallbackBehavior: PriceFeedFtsoV2Connector resolves FTSOv2 through the hard-coded FlareContractRegistry, calls the single configured feed, discards its timestamp, and enforces no maximum age. Successful reads return oracleFailureDetected=false. Registry or FTSO failure reverts before a boolean is returned, so branch shutdown is not activated; there is no cache or alternate source. The Safe owner can replace the feed ID immediately, but this is admin reconfiguration rather than automatic failover.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller can immediately liquidate under-MCR troves; no auction or keeper allowlist applies. The branch Stability Pool offsets at most its deposits minus MIN_BOLD_IN_SP (1e18), preserving that minimum, and any remaining debt and collateral are redistributed to active troves.
branches.backstop: Branch Stability Pool 0x2c817F7159c08d94f09764086330c96Bb3265A2f offsets debt only from deposits above MIN_BOLD_IN_SP (1e18), which is preserved; uncovered debt and collateral are redistributed across surviving FXRP troves. No committed external insurance or auction capital exists.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Anyone can shut the branch when TCR falls below the 105% SCR; shutdown blocks new borrowing while urgent redemption and debt resolution continue. Successful connector calls return oracleFailureDetected=false; registry or FTSO failures revert before that flag can trigger shutdown. Unoffset liquidation debt is redistributed and no separate residual-debt cure is committed.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Possible is now source-backed, not generic uncertainty. CoinGecko and the tracked catalog list one CDP route: Flare proxy 0x6cd3a5ba46fa254d4d2e3c2b37350ae337e94a0f. At historical block 65060608 and fixed 2026-07-15 block 65092269, its EIP-1967 implementation was 0x03dc7269d65018516133987de01104cf2607c884 and admin was 0xd6363e03cf93d35103592f11ae7160179e0be3ff. The verified BoldToken ABI/source has no pause, unpause, holder blacklist, freeze, or dynamic recipient-list function; paused() reverts. transfer and transferFrom only reject the zero address and CDP itself, so the source header's blacklist wording is not a holder blacklist. The token owner was the unchanged 2-of-6 Safe 0xdedda08961216adb9ca09b88986d110127b24270. Its onlyOwner setBranchAddresses can register arbitrary addresses as StabilityPool, TroveManager, BorrowerOperations, and ActivePool; a registered StabilityPool can call sendToPool(sender,pool,amount), and registered StabilityPool, TroveManager, or BorrowerOperations addresses can call burn(account,amount), both without holder approval. setCollateralRegistry supplies another owner-configurable burn caller. Separately, the 1057-byte ProxyAdmin exposes UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0 and its owner was the unchanged EOA 0xfc75f3c7dba8decd0f5c923fe577bf2ff111bce4, which can replace token logic. No active user-specific blacklist or global pause is asserted, so this remains Possible rather than Yes or No. Enosys documentation describes a Flare Liquity V2 friendly fork, but its technical page links the upstream Liquity source; the official flrfinance Bold fork differs from the deployed upgradeable CDP source. The published Enosys docs index exposed no dedicated legal/privacy, proof-of-reserves, or CDP audit page; the official footer Terms target resolved only to a generic Notion landing page, and Archive.org had no snapshot of the reviewed Loans page. Those limitations do not alter the on-chain control finding.

mintAuthority.summary: CDP is minted from Enosys Loans overcollateralized vaults on Flare when users deposit Flare-ecosystem collateral. The CDP token (0x6cd3a5ba...) is an EIP-1967 proxy; its owner is a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 multisig (0xdedda089..., 2-of-6, no modules, no guard). The proxy admin (0xd6363e03) is itself owned by an EOA (0xfc75f3c7). Collateral mint is bounded by per-position overcollateralization and Liquity V2 redemption rules; the admin multisig controls risk parameter updates.

controls.evidence: At Flare block 65060608, the CDP token's EIP-1967 admin slot resolves to 0xd6363e03cf93d35103592f11ae7160179e0be3ff; eth_getCode returns 1057 bytes and UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION() returns "5.0.0", identifying an OpenZeppelin v5 ProxyAdmin whose upgradeAndCall is onlyOwner. owner() on that ProxyAdmin returns 0xfc75f3c7dba8decd0f5c923fe577bf2ff111bce4, and eth_getCode on that address returns 0x (no bytecode, an EOA). This single key can replace the BoldToken implementation and therefore rewrite mint logic and remove every cap.

review.evidence: On-chain reads at Flare block 62712638: CDP token (0x6cd3a5ba46fa254d4d2e3c2b37350ae337e94a0f) is an EIP-1967 upgradeable proxy whose owner is a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 multisig (0xdedda08961216adb9ca09b88986d110127b24270, 2-of-6 threshold, 6 EOA signers, no modules, no guard). The proxy admin (0xd6363e03cf93d35103592f11ae7160179e0be3ff) is separately owned by an EOA (0xfc75f3c7dba8decd0f5c923fe577bf2ff111bce4, confirmed by eth_getCode returning empty bytecode). The 2-of-6 Safe is the effective admin for risk parameter changes on the Enosys Loans protocol.
